purpose: Representation ownership study: a transport representation whose learned state is radiometric (explicit outgoing >= 2-vertex radiance), owned by surface units of ONE object each, with no learned shared decoder; tested for T0 quality, all-local recovery of the teaset T0 -> T3 change, and whole-object oracle selective refit. Written after the T0-only capacity pilot and before any T3 fit, oracle or evaluation of this batch.
living_documents: docs at 6738be1 (object-level intent, 2026-10-12): selection is reported at WHOLE-OBJECT granularity (all units of a dirty part refit; every unit of a clean part frozen). A unit-level oracle subset is run only as a labelled secondary diagnostic (the batch prompt's 'oracle-selected partial-state refit'), never as the main selection result. This batch uses one substrate; the user's O0/O1 preference to compare explicit tables with per-object RNA is recorded for a later batch.
prior_art_audit: workflow wf_9eab5e1a-2d3 + critic: Vertex Features (SA 2025), Neural Radiosity (2021) and OctaOctree NR condition a shared decoder that owns directional/glossy structure; Frequency-Aware Spatio-Angular Gaussians (EGSR 2026), Gaussian Light Transport (SA 2026) and N-D Gaussians (SIGGRAPH 2024) own radiance directly but have no runnable code on this hardware; no released implementation satisfies both local ownership and local support. Teaset BSDF verified: roughconductor Ni_palik, Beckmann (Mitsuba default), alpha 0.05 (tray, tea pot) / 0.1 (milk pot, tin).

representation.unit: one anchor on ONE part (per-part voxel of size h x dominant-normal bin), stored in the part's canonical frame so it moves rigidly with the part
representation.state: per unit an RGB table over the full sphere of outgoing directions (octahedral map, res x res, in the anchor's normal frame: upper hemisphere = front side, lower = back side of two-sided surfaces); entries are linear outgoing radiance of paths with >= 2 asset vertices
representation.query: L_ind(x, w) = sum_k wgt_k(x) * bilinear(table_{a_k}, oct(frame_{a_k}^T w)); wgt = partition-of-unity Wendland C2 weights, radius 1.5 h, of up to 16 anchors on the same part whose normal agrees with the query's geometric normal (dot > 0.3)
representation.shared_computation: fixed only (anchor search, interpolation, frames, octahedral map); no learned shared parameter exists, so 'all-local refit with global computation frozen' coincides with all-object refit
representation.object_model: N_i = all units of part i (plate, teapot2 = milk pot (mover), teapot3 = biscuit tin, teapot4 = tea pot)
representation.direct_light: not owned: the v = 1 (and camera-emitter v = 0) classes are taken from the physical estimator at the current geometry (worklog-24 class images, 1024 spp seed A), as 8DNA computes direct analytically
representation.resolution_choice: T0-only pilot (results/surface_owned_radiance/pilot/h02_r32): after 400 steps T0 total display MAE interaction 0.039 / R_aff_stat 0.045 / R_unaff 0.027 vs 8DNA 0.034 / 0.054 / 0.025, still improving; finer configurations were not tried

supervision.estimator: experiments/8dna_deformation_replication/transport_decomposition.decompose (worklog 24; Mitsuba 3.5.1 prb/path primal re-implementation, validated against Mitsuba C++ path), unchanged
supervision.query: area-uniform point on a part, random side, uniform outgoing direction in that side's hemisphere with cos >= 0.05; ray starts 2e-3 outside along w and points at the point; accepted if the first hit is that point on that part (|hit - x| < 2e-4)
supervision.target: 1-spp MC estimate of the >= 2-vertex outgoing radiance in the CURRENT whole scene (cross-object transport included)
supervision.online: fresh queries and targets every step (no stored dataset)

fit_contract.loss: mean squared error in linear radiance over accepted queries
fit_contract.optimizer: Adam, lr 0.02, cosine to 0.001 over the arm's steps; trainable units held in a sub-table parameter, frozen units read from a constant table
fit_contract.subset_batch: round(global_batch x support_fraction), support_fraction = share of area-uniform surface positions whose stencil reads a trainable unit (same per-unit sample density as the all-object arms)

oracle.role: offline reference-derived upper-bound control; not a runtime mechanism; its cost is reported separately
oracle.method: the same queries (canonical frame) traced in T0 and T3 with common random numbers; per query dL = |L_T3 - L_T0| (RGB mean, >= 2-vertex class); per unit E_u = sum_q w_qu dL_q; per object E_i = sum over its units
oracle.object_dirty_rule: object i is transport-dirty if E_i / sum E >= 0.02; sensitivity at 0.01 and 0.05 reported, never used to change the arms
oracle.unit_mask_diagnostic: M95: smallest top-E_u set covering 95% of sum E_u

arms.A: frozen: T0 tables evaluated at T3 (units move with their part)
arms.B: all-object scratch: every unit, init zeros
arms.C: all-object warm start: every unit, init T0 (identical to all-local refit: no learned shared state)
arms.DG: geometry-dirty only: every unit of the milk pot, warm start; others frozen
arms.E: oracle transport-dirty objects: every unit of each object in D_T, warm start; all other objects frozen (bitwise)
arms.U: diagnostic only: unit-level oracle M95, warm start, everything else frozen
arms.E5: sensitivity: oracle transport-dirty objects at the predeclared 0.05 sensitivity threshold, whole-object warm refit, others frozen; run regardless of whether it differs from E; never replaces E as the primary selection result

evaluation.camera: T3 (and T0 for the own-T0 rule), 512^2, 4 x 4 jittered sub-pixel lattice (seed 5), learned indirect per pixel; total = WL24 class images v0 + v1 of that state + learned indirect
evaluation.references: results/8dna_replication/w21_reference_correction/<state>/gt_A|gt_B.exr; indirect reference = WL24 classes v >= 2 (1024 spp seed A)
evaluation.regions: results/selective_refit_oracle/v1_bc085ea/regions/regions.npz (worklog-30 regions: R_aff_stat, R_unaff, R_mover, R_aff, ...) and per-object pixel masks from its part_T3 map; interaction ROI of gt_design/v2
metrics: display MAE vs reference per region and per object
indirect linear MAE vs the WL24 indirect reference
worklog-22 refit rule on the interaction ROI (own T0 = this representation's T0 total)
transport-change tracking on stable pixels: gain, E_delta, R_delta
angular fidelity: held-out T3 queries (500 000, 32 spp, seed 51051) relative MAE per object
preservation: bitwise parameter identity of frozen objects, pixel identity of pixels reading only frozen units
cost: adaptation latency (T3 handed to snapshot written, excluding evaluation), supervision tracing vs optimisation, samples, updated entries, peak memory

gates.G0_O0_static: T0 composed total error below the reference T0->T3 change in the interaction ROI and R_aff_stat, AND interaction-ROI T0 error <= 1.25 x the released 8DNA T0 error (0.034)
gates.G_local: C (all units, warm) recovers at the budget: interaction-ROI rule (ratio <= 1.25 to own T0 and gain >= 0.5) AND R_delta(R_aff_stat) <= 0.5; if it fails the batch stops before E and attributes

E_screen.quality: E R_aff <= 1.10 x C R_aff (final, each seed)
E_screen.preservation: frozen objects bitwise identical; pixels reading only frozen units identical
E_screen.nontrivial: D_T is a strict subset of the objects; if D_T = all objects, E = C and the result is reported as dense dirty closure
E_screen.cost: t_C(Q*) / t_E(Q*) >= 2 with Q* = 1.10 x C_final R_aff (snapshot resolution); fixed-budget cost reported regardless

gates.thresholds_are: predeclared screening values; raw numbers reported

stop_rules: one candidate; no resolution sweep, new basis, threshold change or extra arm after T3 results

amendments.when: before any evidence run (2026-10-12, smoke profiling)
amendments.what: global batch 1 048 576 -> 524 288 and steps doubled (T0 pretraining 1600 -> 3200, arms 800 -> 1600; snapshots rescaled) to keep the same sample budget: at 1 M queries per step the DrJit wavefront state pushed whole-GPU memory to 15.8 GB (WDDM spill), slowing tracing 3-4x and backward 7x; at 524 288 the step uses 9.4 GB and takes ~0.39 s. No T3 fit, oracle or evaluation had run.

added arm E5 (dirty set at the already-predeclared 0.05 sensitivity threshold). Disclosure: a 2 M-query smoke oracle (pipeline check, not evidence) had shown object shares plate 0.59 / milk pot 0.25 / tea pot 0.13 / tin 0.027, i.e. the primary 0.02 rule may mark every object dirty (E = C). The primary threshold is unchanged; E5 only adds a labelled sensitivity arm so a strict-subset selection is also measured.
